A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Changeling/Legends|skinshifting]] '''Shi'ido''' worked for [[Kerred Santhe the Second]] around [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]]. The [[Shi'ido]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Technometry|cheat by controlling the machines]] while [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] to earn lots of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and used his skinshifting ability to cheat at the same [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], including [[Colliders Casino]], multiple times without arousing suspicion.
